R110 (P4) - per-bank source ownership map for the archive-backed gen7 sfx banks (PS3 NHL 09 / 10 / 12 / 13, X360 NHL 09), derived ONLY from
the published R98 JSON (member identities, wrappers, stored / decoded SHA-256, .ast copies and id checks). No new sweep. For the developer's
next action (receipt 22 s8: archive-backed banks through `locate_member` / chunkzip / RefPack).
Per bank: every copy of the .abk (archive or loose, wrapper, stored / decoded hash), whether copies agree byte-for-byte after unwrap, the
number of stream entries, the .ast copies (source, wrapper, hash, id word = bank 0x2c) and framing status; per tree: counts by source
archive, banks with streams, loose-only .ast files, copy-disagreement list (empty = no conflict to resolve). Equal bytes are reported as
equal bytes; no loose / archive precedence is inferred.
Usage: python r110_archive_backed_bank_source_map.py <out.json>
